mechanism_narrative: A continuing recovery in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT raises weekday foot traffic and spillover purchases, so RETAIL_REC should rise over the next four weeks as commuting volume normalizes from a still-depressed base.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -28.6 to -19.6 while TRANSIT stayed near -46 over the four observed weeks
failure_condition: The hypothesis is rejected if RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to the last four weeks while WORKPLACES continues to rise for two more weekly observations and TRANSIT does not deteriorate further.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL activity falls below its recent elevated range, time spent at home declines and more trips convert into discretionary shopping visits, pushing RETAIL_REC upward within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains below 8 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL eased from 9.6 to 6.9 over the snapshot
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays below 8 for two weeks and RETAIL_REC still fails to rise relative to the prior four-week mean, the mechanism is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed drop in TRANSIT combined with stagnant WORKPLACES signals tightening mobility restrictions or risk avoidance, which reduces shopping trips and pulls RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 3 points week-on-week while WORKPLACES does not rise
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT remained around -46 and WORKPLACES remained below -20 across the snapshot
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if a further TRANSIT decline accompanied by flat or weaker WORKPLACES is followed by stable or higher RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained improvement in PARKS after a weak patch indicates warmer outdoor activity and weekend circulation, which tends to spill into nearby retail visits and lift RETAIL_REC within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises back above -10 after being below -15 the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -9.4 to -18.0 across the snapshot
failure_condition: If PARKS recovers above -10 but RETAIL_REC does not improve versus the last four weeks within 28 days, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, households consolidate essential errands and remain local, leaving less discretionary retail demand and depressing RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays above 6 and RESIDENTIAL stays above 6.5 simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed around 7.4 while RESIDENTIAL stayed above 6.9
failure_condition: The hypothesis is false if both proxies remain elevated yet RETAIL_REC rises above its last-four-week average within two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continued narrowing of the gap between WORKPLACES and TRANSIT implies commuting is recovering faster than broader public-mobility avoidance, which should raise RETAIL_REC with a one-week lag through lunch and after-work purchases.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved every week while TRANSIT remained deeply negative
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES keeps improving relative to TRANSIT but RETAIL_REC does not move up within one week, the claim is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight-restriction regime, a sustained increase in RESIDENTIAL together with weak TRANSIT signals movement suppression that directly cuts nonessential shopping, so RETAIL_REC should decline over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed above baseline while TRANSIT stayed around -46
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline and TRANSIT remains deeply negative but RETAIL_REC nevertheless improves over the next 28 days, the mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS rebounds sharply after a trough, it indicates warmer-weather outdoor substitution and higher weekend outing intensity, which should lift adjacent retail demand over the next two to four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from a prior-week trough
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell to -18.0 after being near -6.6
failure_condition: If PARKS rebounds by at least 5 points from its trough and RETAIL_REC still does not exceed its last-four-week mean within two weeks, the hypothesis is falsified.
